_meta.note: Wiki-harvested seed shard (#902). Which one-handed weapons may be wielded as two copies, one per hand, read as a BLOCKLIST exactly as ring_exclusivity.json is: duplicable unless Exclusive or a Minor Artifact. Fail-closed: a weapon absent from `harvested`, or present with any provenance but `stated`, is NOT duplicable.
_meta.source: ddowiki maintained categories, read 2026-10-17 through the in-app Browser pane: Category:Exclusive, Category:{1,3,4,5} Slot Minor Artifacts, and the binding categories Template:Bind emits (Binds on acquire, Binds on equip, Unbound) — Item: namespace members only.
_meta.mechanic: Exclusive: 'A character is only allowed to have a single version of an Exclusive item in their inventory.' Minor Artifact: 'A character may only equip a single Minor Artifact, regardless of slot.'
_meta.population: Every page title the built catalog's one-handed weapons link to (web/model.js isBothHandsWeapon false; 2,528 titles from 2,531 records). Matched against the category member lists by SHA-256 prefix inside the page; the transferred title-hash string was digest-checked on both sides (e9fdefece96b).
